title: Selecting the correct deployment target: SageMaker vs. ECS vs. EKS vs. Lambda

cues.en: Alright, welcome back to the course.
Today, we're talking about methods for deploying models in production.
cues.zh: 今天談正式環境的模型部署。

cues.en: Now, it might sound complex, but don't worry, you don't need to know much for the exam.
cues.zh: 聽起來複雜，但別擔心，考試不用很多細節。

cues.en: And also it is a very important topic, so it's good to know the basics about it.
cues.zh: 這也很重要，知道基礎很好。

cues.en: So, here's our machine learning pipeline.
We're talking about this step of deployment today.
So, what happens in deploying? How can you deploy models?
cues.zh: 部署會發生什麼？怎麼部署？

cues.en: There are a few methods and the first one is a managed API service.
cues.zh: 幾種方法，第一是受管 API 服務。

cues.en: It's probably the easiest one to use.
Basically, you use SageMaker, SageMaker does everything for you.
cues.zh: 基本上用 SageMaker，替你處理全部。

cues.en: You deploy the model through SageMaker and it creates an API that you can call.
cues.zh: 透過它部署，建立可呼叫 API。

cues.en: What API means is like it stands for application programming interface.
cues.zh: API 是 Application Programming Interface，應用程式介面。

cues.en: But basically, you can interact with this model through other programs, through other software, through other applications and things like that.
cues.zh: 可透過其他程式、軟體與應用和模型互動。

cues.en: So, you can just call the model, give it some data to process and then get a response.
cues.zh: 呼叫、提供資料、取得回應。

cues.en: That's what API is all about.
And here SageMaker does that all for you.
It scales automatically with SageMaker and you don't need to worry about it.
Second one is a self-hosted method.
On the exam you might see something like self-hosted API.
By the way, it doesn't have to be just API.
It can be self-hosted without an API.
cues.zh: 也可自行託管、不用 API。

cues.en: What that means is, for example, you take an EC2 server and there you would put your model there and then you would set up an API, your own API, that you would need to scale.
cues.zh: 例如 EC2 伺服器，放模型，自設 API，也自己負責擴展。

cues.en: Like if the number of requests increases, you would need to make sure this whole thing scales well.
cues.zh: 請求量增加，要確保能擴展。

cues.en: So, you would be taking care of this fully.
Or if you don't want do an API, you might want to embed it.
So, if you build a model to embed directly into a product without needing to like call it externally with an API, you might also wanna do that.
cues.zh: 模型直接嵌進產品，不外部呼叫，也可以。

cues.en: So, that's this icon, what that icon represents, like embedding the model directly into an app or a product.
cues.zh: 圖示代表直接嵌進應用或產品。

cues.en: And that's also an option if you're doing it in the self-hosted way.
The next one is serverless API, very similar to kind of like the managed API service.
cues.zh: 下一種 Serverless API，很像受管 API。

cues.en: But here, yeah, or it's kind of like a hybrid because here you're using Lambda, you're deploying your model and you get an API that also scales,
cues.zh: 或者混合，使用 Lambda 部署，得到可擴展 API，

cues.en: but it can be prone to cold starts.
So, be careful because it's not always on.
It's like an on-demand kind of thing.
When somebody needs to use your model, it might take a few moments to get it going because it's not the same as a managed API source
cues.zh: 有人用模型，可能要等一下，不像一直啟動的

cues.en: where it's always on.
Next option is container deployment.
Now, these last options are not that important for the exam, but it's still good to know about them.
cues.zh: 最後幾種對考試較不重要，但值得知道。

cues.en: Container deployment where you deploy a model through a container, usually that's an API as well.
cues.zh: 透過容器部署，通常也有 API。

cues.en: So, you containerize your model.
Now you can deploy it in different environments.
Usually an API is in there as well.
But you know, there are other options as well with containers too.
And edge deployment is when you put your model directly on edge devices.
cues.zh: 邊緣部署，模型直接放邊緣裝置。

cues.en: So, it works not just through the cloud, but actually works on somebody's mobile phone or on somebody's computer when they need to call it.
cues.zh: 不只在雲端，也在手機或電腦本機執行。

cues.en: And that is usually done through embedding a model directly into the product.
So for the exam, these three are the most important ones.
Again, just only need to know the overview of what these services or these methods are and how they differ.
cues.zh: 知道概觀、方法與差異即可。

cues.en: Here's a quick summary of what we discussed.
I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
And until then, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
